name: isabella-villase-or-genesisai
description: Isabella Villaseñor AI — Genesis TINA v40.0.0. Cognitive Orchestrator & Civilizational Memory OS.

scripts.build: node scripts/repository-assurance.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vitest run && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --target=node24 --outfile=dist/server.js && node --check src/ui/app.js && node scripts/ui-smoke.mjs && node scripts/runtime-smoke.mjs && corepack pnpm run security:suite
scripts.build:dist: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --target=node24 --outfile=dist/server.js && node --check src/ui/app.js && node scripts/ui-smoke.mjs
scripts.validate: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run build
scripts.postgres:e2e: corepack pnpm run build:dist && node scripts/postgres-e2e.mjs
scripts.deploy:verify: docker build --tag isabella-genesisai:verify . && corepack pnpm run smoke:runtime && kubectl apply --dry-run=server -k k8s/
